verdict.rationale: Apify positions itself as a platform for AI agents, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair capability to ask about. However, the evidence only documents Apify acting as an MCP server that exposes Actors to other agents (apify-docs-10, apify-probe-3). That server role does not count toward this story. Nothing in the pack shows Apify connecting to or plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
